guide-text:
Crafting
Four ropes or four matching metal chains plus one stick make a basic lasso. Add one plain leather for reinforcement. Supported metals: copper, tin bronze, bismuth bronze, black bronze, iron, meteoric iron and steel. Gold and silver are excluded.

Durability and catch chance
Reinforced catch chance rises from 25% for rope to 100% for steel; basic lassos use 60% of the reinforced chance for the same material. Basic metal durability matches the vanilla axe of the same material. Large targets lose up to three percentage points; actual chances stay between 5% and 100%.

Throwing and states
Left-click throws up to eight blocks with an eight-block line and a one-second cooldown. Basic rope costs two durability, reinforced rope one, and chain two, including misses. A physical hit deals 0.1 base blunt damage without knockback, even if the catch roll fails. Dodging or block cover prevents impact damage. lasso is the held dragging state; bound is binding; hogtied also locks movement controls, jumping and interaction.

Binding and recovery
Right-click a caught target to bind; sneak-right-click to hogtie. Right-click a block or another entity to anchor the line, or empty space to follow the owner again. The owner right-clicks to release and recover the original lasso and remaining durability. Sneak-right-click with an empty active slot restores a bound/hogtied target to the held lasso. Changing slots, disconnecting or dying turns the link into bound; detached links cannot be recovered by the former owner.

Dragging and escape
Rope animals roll once per second while the line is taut; lower health and smaller size reduce the chance, and reinforcement reduces it by 35%. A successful escape destroys the lasso. Rope breaks after ten consecutive checks fail to pull a blocked target within line length. Metal does not roll for animal escape, dragging costs no durability, and walls or tall obstacles cannot break it. Players have five seconds to press G once while holding the matching knife or axe. Escaping consumes 100/200/300/400/500/600/700/800 lasso durability for rope/copper/tin bronze/bismuth bronze/black bronze/iron/meteoric iron/steel; an insufficient lasso breaks, otherwise the damaged lasso is returned.

Cutting
Other players must hold the correct tool for three seconds: stone knife for rope, copper axe for copper, bronze axe for the three bronzes, iron axe for iron/meteoric iron, and steel axe for steel. Cutting costs tool durability and destroys the lasso.
itemdesc-rope: Hold a stick in the left hand and at least four ropes in the right, then hold right-click for 2.5 seconds to craft a basic lasso. Hold any basic lasso in the left hand and plain leather in the right, then hold right-click for 2.5 seconds to reinforce it without restoring lost durability. Durability 160/320 and base catch chance 15%/25%. Left-click throws eight blocks with a one-second cooldown; physical hits deal 0.1 base damage even if the catch fails. Right-click binds; sneak-right-click hogties. Animals can move and may escape. A blocked line breaks after ten failed pull checks. The owner can release and recover it, or restore it with sneak-right-click and an empty slot. Others need a stone knife for three seconds. To recover all materials from an unused lasso, hold it in the left hand and any knife in the right hand, then hold right-click for five seconds.
itemdesc-metal: Hold a stick in the left hand and at least four matching chains in the right, then hold right-click for 2.5 seconds to craft a basic lasso. Hold any basic lasso in the left hand and plain leather in the right, then hold right-click for 2.5 seconds to reinforce it without restoring lost durability. Supports copper, the three bronzes, iron, meteoric iron and steel; excludes gold and silver. Basic durability matches vanilla axes, doubled for reinforcement. Left-click throws eight blocks with a one-second cooldown; physical hits deal 0.1 base damage even if the catch fails. Right-click binds; sneak-right-click hogties. Animals cannot escape; dragging costs no durability and obstacles cannot break the chain. The owner can release or restore it; others need the matching axe for three seconds. To recover all materials from an unused lasso, hold it in the left hand and any knife in the right hand, then hold right-click for five seconds.
